name: Station F
description: The world's biggest startup campus, in a converted railway depot in the 13th arrondissement. Home to 30+ startup programs run by STATION F and partners, with mentoring offices, events and housing for founders.
access_note: The startup zone is for resident startups and programs. Visitors get in with an invitation, an event ticket or a free guided visit; the food hall La Felicità is open to everyone at lunch and dinner.

name: J floor
description: Non-profit founder community and shared workspace in Zurich for solo founders and small teams at the earliest stage, with no fees and no equity. It grew out of ETH's Student Project House and opened its own rooms in February 2026.
access_note: A private community with limited desks, not a drop-in space. Sign up through the website and get accepted before you come.
open_questions: Confirm the street address (Josefstrasse 219, 8005 Zürich is the registered seat and where press places it; the website names none) and whether they use a second space.
Day passes or visits for non-members?

name: Founders House
description: Non-profit hub for early-stage Nordic AI founders, based at the L26 tech hub in central Stockholm. Residents get sponsored desks or private offices with 24/7 access; members and the wider community are invited to events.
access_note: Desks and offices go to residents chosen in application rounds (next batch from November 2026). Members and the community can join selected events, but cannot use the workspace.
open_questions: Confirm the street address: Luntmakargatan 26 (L26 website, Dagens Industri) vs 34 (privacy policy and Luma events); the website names none.
Day passes or visits for non-members?

name: The Sandbox
description: Founder residency and shared space for technical builders working full-time on a new venture, inside The Delta Campus in Neukölln. Run by {Tech: Europe} with no fees, no equity and no fixed cohort.
access_note: Applications are always open; no booking, no drop-in. Desks are for full-time builders aiming for a 100bn€ company, not for part-time or bootstrapped side projects.

name: Founders House Helsinki (Kasvutalo)
description: Selective, non-profit founder community with free workspace on the top floor of Kasvutalo (formerly Sähkötalo), Alvar Aalto's 1973 building in Kamppi. Room for up to 15 founding teams, no equity and no program. Opened in February 2026.
access_note: Residents are picked in competitive application rounds and only contacted if taken forward. Open to founders based in Finland or relocating there. Not a drop-in space.
notes: The website's own coordinates (24.925 E) are about 350 m west of the building; the pin uses the geocoded Malminrinne 6 instead.
